name: Geode
description: A lumpy, rough-skinned stone, heavier than it looks. Shake it and nothing rattles, but there's a hairline crack, and something in it catches the light.
notes: Crack it open with a pickaxe (the pick's "Crack a geode…") for the rough gem inside. Takes 10 minutes and wears the pick a little.
Found in the rock at mining seams.
